{{Top}}
[[File:Mustafar_mining_droids.jpg|thumb|280px|[[Mustafar panning droid]]s, [[Mining Droid MK3|mining droids MK3]] and [[DLC-13 Mining Droid|DLC-13 mining droids]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].]]
'''Mining droids''' were [[Class five droid/Legends|fifth-degree]] [[Droid/Legends|automatons]] used throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|history]] to conduct [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations without the need for manual labor.

Around five hundred years before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], [[Outer Rim Oreworks Company]] sent mining droids to fully automate their mine [[ORO Mining Station LM0228]] in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. [[Administrator (ORO)|Administrator]] [[Guther Bartyn]] reprogrammed these droids and used them for other purposes, including fish processing and city building; but he later returned them to the mines.<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref> Five centuries later, the droids were still active in the mine and, when their habitat was invaded by [[Menahuun]]s, they simply continued with their work.<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref>
